screens.title: Main menu
screens.note: Boot screen. The seven main buttons; QUIT is at the bottom right.

screens.title: Free Game: island and difficulty
screens.note: Ten islands in an eight-row scrollable list, three difficulty buttons, Start and Cancel. A row must be selected before Start.

screens.title: Campaign select
screens.note: Eight campaign rows. Rows 1-4 are unlocked by `save/dino.dat`; the harness writes 0x0F for them.

screens.title: Campaign briefing / mission list
screens.note: Mission rows are 17 px apart; the harness uses `142 + row*17 + 8`.

screens.title: Load game
screens.note: The save-name list is the clickable region; row height has not been measured against a populated list yet.

screens.title: Main-menu options
screens.note: Three horizontal sliders and six value indicators. The port renders this page but the controls are not wired yet.

controls.name: OPTIONS_GRAPH_MIXING_INDICATION
controls.label: This change will take effect the next time the game is launched.
controls.resolved_hint: This change will take effect the next time the game is launched.

screens.title: Cinematics
screens.note: Video list with Start and Cancel.

screens.title: Credits
screens.note: Single OK button.

screens.title: Loading cover
screens.note: No interactive controls; it is a timed cover frame.

screens.title: Park HUD (always visible)
screens.note: Visible for the whole park session. Right panel opens the six main panels; gauge opens budget/visitors/dino-list/show-list/paddock-list; nav and map controls move the camera.

screens.title: Construction bar
screens.note: Three sub-buttons: kit, fence and ready-made show. It is hidden while one of those sub-panels is open.

screens.title: Construction kit (attraction editor)
screens.note: Switches on the left choose seat count, judge type, feature category and cage size; the feature tiles share one 3x3 area.

screens.title: Fence construction
screens.note: Fence name box plus lunch-box and observation-area switches.

screens.title: Ready-made show list
screens.note: Seven-column list of pre-built attractions; Validate/Cancel at the bottom.

screens.title: Road / metro construction
screens.note: Road and metro mode switches plus the farm building; close with PUTBACK_PANEL_BUTTON.

screens.title: Buildings and shops
screens.note: Six category tabs. Each category shows five product buttons at the same five y positions; only the active category is clickable.

screens.title: Dinosaur purchase / save
screens.note: Dinosaur list, description and price. The SAVE name is `DINO_ACHAT_SAVE_OUTCOME_SAVE`; it purchases/saves the selected dinosaur, not a save-game slot.

screens.title: In-park options / save / load
screens.note: Top row switches between options, save and load. The save tab shows `OPTIONS_SAVE_NAMES_LIST` (12-px rows), the name edit box and Validate/Cancel; those save controls are hidden until the Save tab is selected.

screens.title: Mission / objectives
screens.note: Opened by the campaign objective light, not by a HUD button. Two scrolling text zones and an OK button.

screens.title: Dinosaur list
screens.note: Five 64x64 snapshot slots per page, 85 px apart, with sort buttons on the left and page scroll on the right.

screens.title: Show / attraction list
screens.note: Ten rows, 29 px apart. Each row has selection light, permutation, name, lock/unlock and iteration buttons.

screens.title: Paddock / fence list
screens.note: Five snapshot slots and page scroll. The HUD paddock button opens this panel, not CAGE_LIST_PANEL.

screens.title: Cage list (legacy)
screens.note: Never selected by the HUD controller in retail; kept for completeness. `ATTRACTION_LIST_OUTCOME_CAGE_LIST` is invisible.

screens.title: Laboratory main
screens.note: Four lab centres (breed, modify, clone, fridge) and Exit. The two patient lights are selection indicators.

screens.title: Laboratory: breed
screens.note: Four gene tabs (physical, adornment, texture, general). Only one gene group is visible at a time; the variation buttons in the other groups are inactive until their tab is selected.

screens.title: Laboratory: modify
screens.note: Three beam buttons plus fence/fridge/back/exit.

screens.title: Laboratory: fridge / egg storage
screens.note: Eight 45x75 egg slots in two rows, name edit, Sell/Fence/Back/Exit.

screens.title: Laboratory: clone
screens.note: Clone trigger, offspring name, fence/fridge/back/exit.

screens.title: Food distribution
screens.note: Opened by selecting a feeder/food dispenser in the park; not a HUD button and not ported yet. Vegetarian/carnivore choices and ten 15-px time slots.

screens.title: Attraction stats
screens.note: Also reachable from `ATTRACTION_LIST_OUTCOME_STATS`. Close and open-show-list buttons on the right.

screens.title: Dinosaur info / portrait
screens.note: Selection-driven: click a dinosaur in the park. The portrait root overlaps the top of the info strip; its teleport and next-dinosaur buttons are there.

screens.title: Budget ledger
screens.note: Display-only ledger with a single close button.

screens.title: Visitor statistics
screens.note: Display-only statistics with a single close button.

screens.title: Cage / paddock info
screens.note: Selection-driven: click a cage or paddock. Assign/unassign share one position; team switches are 32x33.

screens.title: Building info
screens.note: Selection-driven and display-only: no interactive widgets.

screens.title: Security staff panel
screens.note: Selection/context panel; not wired to a HUD opener in the port. Two 13-px up/down pairs.

screens.title: Food staff panel
screens.note: Selection/context panel; hire/fire feeder up/down buttons.

screens.title: Dinosaur placement marker
screens.note: 1x1 placement marker; no interactive widgets.

screens.title: Campaign objective light
screens.note: 20x100 campaign indicator at the left edge; visible only while a mission objective is active. Opens MISSION_PANEL.

screens.title: Warning dialog
screens.note: Modal warning, e.g. an invalid purchase or placement. Centred by ALIGN_CENTER; the outcome icon closes it.

screens.title: Request dialog
screens.note: Modal visitor/request prompt. Validate and Cancel sit side by side at the bottom.

screens.title: Campaign-end dialog
screens.note: Campaign completion panel; the outcome icon closes it.

screens.title: Show radial menu (unused data)
screens.note: Dead data: no executable string references and the icon names do not exist in any GraphicDB. Do not test.

screens.title: Building radial menu (unused data)
screens.note: Dead data; do not test.

screens.note: Dead data; do not test.
